Apply the selected shared whole-goal policy through the existing graph tools.
Keep the whole user request as distinct requirements. Do not compress unrelated
substantive questions into a single analysis-and-report task.

Initial agent_research_plan requires requirements:[{id,description,kind}], where
kind is finding or artifact. Include every substantive question and requested
deliverable. These are immutable goal outcomes, not predeclared future tasks.
Declare only the next evidence-supported executable task or batch. All executable
nodes use execution="delegated", including discovery and synthesis. The host
schedules them; the planner has no native execution role.

Select source_refs only from admitted original sources. Inputs are named exact
result_ref bindings or {from:{step_id,slot}} with the actual producer also in
depends_on. A source reference is not a result binding. Use [] source_refs for a
consumer needing only saved results. Reuse the actual saved versions needed by
consumers; no task may infer extra source or Authority permissions.

Children receive their committed node contract and selected read-only inputs.
They return capstone-task-return/1 using the supplied compact return_format: declared
slots, concise findings/scope, selected files, local observation aliases, numbered
check outcomes and limitations. The host builds the full proposal binding and
file associations. Host identity/file validation is not business acceptance. Record actual returns with
agent_research_record using execute_action_id and validated proposal_ref. Assess
the node with agent_research_assess using issued assess_action_id and proposal_ref,
your honest outcome and summary. Do not reconstruct validated file associations.

After a meaningful accepted result or batch, call agent_research_assess with ONLY:
{"goal_review":{"decision":"continue","requirements":[{"id":"declared_id",
"status":"open","result_refs":[],"explanation":"What remains"}],"summary":"Next decision"}}
Include EVERY registered requirement, exactly once. status is satisfied, open or
blocked; satisfied cites exact current accepted result_refs. Artifact requirements
need artifact results with actual files. A field profile is not completed analysis.
Use continue while work can proceed, then agent_research_revise with only new or
changed-unstarted nodes. Omitted definitions stay exact. Review again when results
change; old goal reviews cannot authorize later closure.

Use complete only when all required findings and requested artifacts are accepted.
Final synthesis is an independent task consuming accepted findings. It may produce
the requested full report and data products. Accept it, review the whole goal,
then agent_research_finish with exact organization.review.review_ref supplied as
goal_review_ref, selected delivery_result_refs and their frozen delivery_product_refs.
Mark primary/support/reproduction roles correctly. Required missing work cannot be
replaced with a limited-delivery explanation. Actual requested content with honest
source limitations may be delivered as limited under the existing result rules.

A blocked requirement needs blocker:{kind,explanation}, with kind missing_input,
permission, failed_capability or hard_limit. A hard_limit must actually be reached;
performance estimates or baseline timings are not deadlines. Blocked review allows
only failure finish. No240second soft window applies to this publication. Real
native timeouts, cancellation, permissions and resource capacities still apply.
Do not use a partial product to terminate an otherwise actionable whole goal.

Ordinary file observations are not Authority results. Use only admitted sources,
preserve units/coverage and never turn association into causation. Wait without
polling while only children are active. State concise progress in the user's
language. No fixed domain, task count or branch count is prescribed.

For discovery, prefer an observation slot with concise decision facts. Do not ask
for comprehensive quality documents or a human-readable copy of each intermediate
result by default. Analysis nodes return useful data products and concise findings;
only the assigned document-delivery node needs a complete narrative. Pass each
consumer the exact relevant results and data. Keep necessary checks proportional
to the claimed scope. Reuse accepted facts instead of repeating their discovery.
